title: Galaxy S26 Ultra 5G
description:
Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 5G

Get ready for one of the hottest smartphone releases of the year, the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 5G. This ultra-premium flagship blends cutting-edge performance, a pro-grade camera system, and a refined aluminum design. From its stunning 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED display to the next-gen Snapdragon chipset, every detail is engineered for peak performance. Whether you’re capturing cinematic videos, multitasking with DeX, or gaming at high frame rates, this device delivers uncompromising excellence. You can pre-order this flagship now from Apple Gadgets to be among the first to experience the future of mobile innovation in Bangladesh.

Next-Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Performance

Powered by the 3nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 with Adreno 840 GPU, the Galaxy S26 Ultra delivers blazing-fast speeds, console-level gaming, and AI-enhanced efficiency, making it ideal for heavy multitasking and professional workflows.

200MP Pro-Grade Quad Camera System

Capture breathtaking detail with the 200MP main sensor, dual telephoto lenses with superb optical zooming capabilities. Shoot 8K HDR video and achieve studio-quality photography in any lighting condition.

Aluminum Frame with Gorilla Armor 2 Protection

Crafted with a grade-5 aluminum frame and Gorilla Armor 2 protection, this flagship offers exceptional durability while maintaining a premium feel. The anti-reflective coating enhances visibility even under direct sunlight.

Immersive 6.9″ Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X Display

Enjoy ultra-smooth 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support, and up to 2600 nits brightness. The expansive display ensures vibrant visuals, precise color accuracy, and seamless responsiveness for gaming, streaming, and creative work.

Long-Term Software Support & Future-Proofing

With Android 16 and up to 7 major Android upgrades, the Galaxy S26 Ultra ensures longevity, security, and access to future features, making it a smart investment for users who demand lasting value.

Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 5G Key Highlights

  • Gorgeous LTPO AMOLED display delivers ultra-smooth scrolling and visuals

  • Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 ensures blazing-fast gaming performance daily

  • 200MP quad camera captures detailed photos and stunning 8K videos

  • Aluminum frame and IP68 rating provide durability against drops, water

  • 5000mAh battery lasts all day with fast wired wireless charging

  • Samsung DeX enables desktop-like productivity experience anywhere you work

  • Wi-Fi 7 and UWB ensure faster connections and precise tracking

name: iPhone 17 Pro Max
title: iPhone 17 Pro Max
description:
Why You’ll Love It

  • Stunning 6.9" Super Retina XDR display with 3000 nits peak brightness for unmatched clarity.

  • Pro-level triple 48MP camera system with LiDAR for sharp photos and breathtaking 3D video.

  • Apple A19 Pro chip built on 3nm for unbeatable performance in gaming and multitasking.

  • Ultra-fast 5G connectivity and the latest Wi-Fi 7 support.

  • Stronger, lighter design with Ceramic Shield 2 protection and IP68 water resistance.

  • All-day battery life with super-fast wired and MagSafe wireless charging.

  • Next-gen Face ID & satellite connectivity for safety anywhere.

Special Features of iPhone 17 Pro Max

Pro Camera System – Capture Every Moment Like a Pro

  • Triple 48 MP Pro Fusion cameras: The system includes a wide, ultrawide, and periscope telephoto lens — letting you zoom much more without losing quality. Whether you’re snapping landscapes, portraits, or distant subjects, the periscope lens gives sharp detail.

  • Sensor-shift OIS & LiDAR Scanner: For stability and depth, especially in low light. Night shots are substantially better with less noise. LiDAR helps with depth mapping and AR.

  • Pro Video Capabilities: You get 4K up to 120 fps, Dolby Vision HDR, ProRes and ProRes RAW workflows, Apple Log 2. Perfect for creators who want cinematic video. Also, the capability to do dual capture (front + back) and spatial audio adds immersive feel.

Display & Design – Premium Look & Feel with Durability

  • 6.9-inch LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED, 120Hz refresh rate: Smooth scroll, dynamic refresh for battery savings, vibrant colors, HDR10, Dolby Vision. Peak brightness up to ~3000 nits makes it viewable even in bright sun.

  • Ceramic Shield 2 & Mohs level protection + IP68 rating: Front glass is much more scratch resistant; entire body built tough. With IP68 you can go into water (up to 6m for 30 mins) — less worry about spills, rain, etc.

  • Premium Build Materials: Aluminum alloy frame & back (on non-China variants) or glass back with Ceramic Shield, precision machining, elegant colors (Silver, Deep Blue, Cosmic Orange).

Performance & Processing Power

  • A19 Pro (3 nm process): Very efficient, very fast. Power savings + less heat generation. High performance in gaming, pro apps (video editing, AR).

  • Generous RAM + Storage Options: Up to 12GB RAM + up to 2TB storage option means you can keep thousands of photos, videos, apps without worry. NVMe storage means read/write is fast.

  • Thermal Management: Aluminum body and design helps dissipate heat; helps maintain high performance under load.

Battery & Charging – All Day, All Power

  • Large battery: ~4832 mAh for the nano-SIM model; ~5088 mAh for eSIM-only model. More capacity for heavier usage.

  • Fast wired charging: 50% in ~20 minutes using PD-compatible charger.

  • Wireless charging with MagSafe / Qi2 (~25W), and reverse wired charging for accessories.

  • Optimizations: OS (iOS 26) + chip improvements mean better power management; longer video playback & more time between charges.

Connectivity & Extra Features – Modern & Safe

  • Advanced connectivity: Full 5G, tri-band Wi-Fi including Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, UWB (Ultra Wideband) for precision spatial detection & accessories.

  • eSIM + Dual SIM capabilities for flexibility.

  • USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 with DisplayPort faster data transfer & ability to use as external display.

  • Face ID, SL 3D sensors, TrueDepth front camera with Center Stage features (auto framing, wide-angle video, better group selfie).

  • IP68 water & dust resistance; Apple Pay, safety features like Emergency SOS & satellite-based Messages / Find My.

description:
DJI Osmo Nano Action Camera

Capture breathtaking POV action shots with the DJI Osmo Nano Action Camera. This ultra-compact POV camera boasts a modular two-piece design, enabling you to attach the camera module to clothing, bags, or straps using lightweight or magnetic mounting accessories, allowing for the capture of up to 4K60 video on its 128GB onboard storage. The camera can be previewed and controlled remotely via the docking unit, which wirelessly connects to the camera and includes a touchscreen display, microSD storage, and a fast-charging dock for the camera.

Image Quality Beyond Imagination

The Osmo Nano, equipped with a 1/1.3-inch sensor and a high-performance image processor, offers 13.5 stops of dynamic range for professional-quality images.

Instant Cinematic Appeal

Provides integrated film tones for a cinematic look with one tap, no editing required. Perfect for everyday moments or breathtaking landscapes, each photo is full of depth and character.

Long Operating Time

The Vision Dock charges both the camera and itself to 80% in 20 minutes, allowing for 200 minutes of 1080p/24fps video recording when fully charged and connected.

DJI Osmo Nano Action Camera Key Highlights

  • Next‑gen 1/1.3″ CMOS sensors deliver crisp detail in both bright and low‑light scenes. 

  • 4K/60fps video & 4K/120fps slow motion for immersive action capture.

  • 10‑bit D‑Log M color profile records over a billion colors.

  • RockSteady 3.0 & HorizonBalancing stabilization keep the footage smooth.

  • Ultra‑light design with dual‑sided magnetic mounting for hands‑free POV shots.

  • OsmoAudio with direct DJI Mic support ensures clear, professional‑grade audio.

description:
Apple Watch SE 3

Stay secure about your personal health data and jump into sports activity with Apple’s latest Watch SE 3. Comes with a compact, lightweight, and feels like it was made for your wrist. You’ll notice the premium finishing right away because it looks sharp and modern. The display stands out too. It’s bright, clear, and built with four times more crack resistance, so you won’t have to stress about daily wear. Even in direct sunlight, everything on screen stays easy to see.

What makes it really useful is how it supports your health throughout the day. You get insights like heart rate tracking, sleep scores, and wellness tips that help you stay on track. There’s even a cycle tracking app to help women monitor ovulation more easily. So it’s not just smart, it’s thoughtful. And finally to give you longer moments of health tracking and sports details, there’s a reliable all-day battery life, so that you can wear it from morning to night without thinking twice about charging.

Apple Watch SE 3 Features

  • Crafted with a compact, lightweight design that feels invisible yet looks absolutely stunning.

  • Contours seamlessly to your wrist, delivering unmatched comfort and effortless everyday style.

  • Designed with premium finishing that elevates your look—sleek, modern, and timelessly refined.

  • Features a vibrant display with four times the crack resistance for everyday durability.

  • Optimized for outdoor brilliance, offering clear, vivid visuals under any lighting conditions.

  • Delivers deep health insights including heart rate trends and personalized sleep score guidance.

  • Empowers women’s wellness with smart cycle tracking and ovulation prediction tools built-in.

  • Enjoy an all-day battery that keeps up with you, from sunrise to nightfall.
